description: Partially update a board card: rename it, move it to another stage, or set its users (owners) and contacts (leads). user_ids / contact_ids replace the current sets. Trengo: PUT /boards/{boardId}/cards/{cardId}.

contact_ids.description: Trengo contact ids on the card, e.g. leads (replaces the set).

stage_id.description: Move the card to this stage.

user_ids.description: Trengo user ids on the card, e.g. deal owners (replaces the set).

name: trengo_update_board_card
title: Update a board card
